title: senecio lactucoides
intro: Senecio lactucoides, commonly known as Jacob's ladder or white Jacob's ladder, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Senecio lactucoides include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to improve digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Senecio lactucoides include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
